description:
- Build with Telegram bot for the best user experience
- A comprehensive TypeScript plugin for interacting with IncrementFi's decentralized exchange (DEX) on the Flow blockchain.
- This plugin integrates with the common account management system to provide CPAMM (Constant Product Automated Market Maker) functionality, including pool creation, liquidity management, and token swapping.
how_its_made: By utilizing the Eliza Lightweight Framework, we built the plugins especially for the integration with incrementFi and utilizes the potentials for the upcoming users. The eliza framework enabled developers to contribute to build the plugins. This projects also utilized the claude model and with the interaction with characters.
